en.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the supreme status of the righteous, particularly the Ahl al-Bayt, whose spiritual elevation mirrors the physical grandeur of Paradise. This description serves as both a promise for the faithful and a contrast to the fate of the disbelievers mentioned in the surrounding verses.
